12.title: sitNature

metadata.name: 🖼️ Generate a Nature photo
metadata.description: Photographs in the dataset with these captions tend to showcase animals/nature in extraordinary positions and situations, works similarly to “Award-Winning” but is only for nature. This will also make animals/nature look more real and accurate.
metadata.author: Prompt Engineering Guide

13.title: quaTiltShift

metadata.name: 🖼️ Generate a Tilt-shift photo
metadata.description: select a text and Tilt-shift photo about it will be generated using Dalle-2
metadata.author: Prompt Engineering Guide

14.title: quaMacro

metadata.name: 🖼️ Generate a Macro photo
metadata.description: select a text and Macro photo about it will be generated using Dalle-2
metadata.author: Prompt Engineering Guide

15.title: quaCinematic

metadata.name: 🖼️ Generate a cinematic movie photo
metadata.description: Adds a very atmospheric movie-like feel to the image, with great color tones and image composure, and can also add nice background blur and pretty camera angles.
metadata.author: Prompt Engineering Guide

16.title: quaBokeh

metadata.name: 🖼️ Generate a Bokeh photo
metadata.description: Enforce a large amount of background blur with clear outer bands, this can be used as a replacement for the “mm lens” prompts. Also could cause the subject to be closer to the camera.
metadata.author: Prompt Engineering Guide

17.title: qua85mm

metadata.name: 🖼️ Generate a 85mm lens photo
metadata.description: Quite zoomed in photo, a lot of background blur and detail on subject
metadata.author: Prompt Engineering Guide

18.title: qua35mm

metadata.name: 🖼️ Generate a 35mm lens photo
metadata.description: Reasonable amount of background blur, reasonable zoom level.
metadata.author: Prompt Engineering Guide

19.title: qua4K

metadata.name: 🖼️ Generate a 4K/8K photo
metadata.description: Images in the dataset with the caption “4K/8K” are of high production value therefore will look more professionally photographed if you add this modifier.
metadata.author: Prompt Engineering Guide

20.title: qua200mm

metadata.name: 🖼️ Generate a 200mm lens photo
metadata.description: Extremely zoomed in photo, tons of background blur, & will look like it was photographed from a far distance and then zoomed in a lot (good for photos of flying birds, small animals).
metadata.author: Prompt Engineering Guide

21.title: qua15mm

metadata.name: 🖼️ Generate a 15mm wide-angle lens photo
metadata.description: Very wide image with lots of information in the image.
metadata.author: Prompt Engineering Guide

22.title: modPhotorealistic

metadata.name: 🖼️ Generate a Photorealistic photo
metadata.description: This will make the art have a lot of detail, but still be stylized, and it will still be art. Do NOT use this if you want to create a prompt which looks like a real photo, as the term “photorealistic” is used to describe an artificial image that looks real, not a real photo.
metadata.author: Prompt Engineering Guide

23.title: modFanart

metadata.name: 🖼️ Generate a Fanart photo
metadata.description: This gives the generation a cute young amateur graphic design feel, adding hearts to the image and so on.
metadata.author: Prompt Engineering Guide

24.title: modDetailed

metadata.name: 🖼️ Generate a photo, with more precise details
metadata.description: Adds more precise details to the output, instead of simple art, but can also make the art overwhelming/over the top in small details.
metadata.author: Prompt Engineering Guide

25.title: modAwardWinning

metadata.name: 🖼️ Generate a Award-Winning Art photo
metadata.description: Images in the dataset with captions like “Award-Winning Art” are usually extremely creative and original, so using this modifier can greatly improve the quality and inventiveness of your generations.
metadata.author: Prompt Engineering Guide

26.title: modArtStation

metadata.name: 🖼️ Generate a Trending on ArtStation photo
metadata.description: This modifier will sample extra training data from the most-liked artwork from the website ArtStation. Images which trend on ArtStation are usually very visually-appealing as it means the ArtStation community enjoys those images, so filtering the data to produce images similar to those will greatly increase the quality of the generated art.
metadata.author: Prompt Engineering Guide

27.title: ligStudio

metadata.name: 🖼️ Generate a Studio Lighting photo
metadata.description: Dark/light background is imposed behind the subject, lighting accentuates details of the figure in the foreground.
metadata.author: Prompt Engineering Guide

28.title: ligGoldenHour

metadata.name: 🖼️ Generate a Golden Hour Sunlight photo
metadata.description: The hour just after sunrise or just before sunset when the natural light is soft and warm. Increases the temperature of generations.
metadata.author: Prompt Engineering Guide

29.title: ligFlare

metadata.name: 🖼️ Generate a Lens Flare photo
metadata.description: Adds a streak of light onto an image generation, creating the appearance of a bright light source being just outside of the frame.
metadata.author: Prompt Engineering Guide

30.title: ligCinematic

metadata.name: 🖼️ Generate a Cinematic Lighting photo
metadata.description: Movie-like imagery with dramatic shadowing and very strong vibrancy, it also seems to add sun rays whenever it can.
metadata.author: Prompt Engineering Guide

31.title: ligAmbient

metadata.name: 🖼️ Generate a Ambient Lighting photo
metadata.description: select a text and ambient lighting photo about it will be generated using Dalle-2
metadata.author: Prompt Engineering Guide
